transcript_summary: Brandon Anderson and Matt Moore analyze the Week 8 NFL slate on The Action Network Podcast, breaking down prop ladders, sandbox picks, and game matchups. analysis_notes.summary: Arizona corners are young, injured, and left on islands by DC Nick Rallis, giving up 89 receiving yards per game and 5 TDs to opposing WR1s.
analysis_notes.speaker: Brandon Anderson
analysis_notes.quote: Arizona corners are young, they're not healthy... Nick Rallis is leaving them on islands.

analysis_notes.topic: Todd Bowles blitz scheme and RB targets
analysis_notes.summary: Todd Bowles' blitzes force quick short throws, leaving running backs open for high target volume and yards after catch.
analysis_notes.speaker: Matt Moore
analysis_notes.quote: Bowles is going to bring the heat, and they're going to get the ball out quickly.

analysis_notes.summary: Jaleel McLaughlin leads Denver in early-down, 3rd-down, and red-zone snaps, making him the clear lead back over Dobbs and Harvey.
analysis_notes.speaker: Brandon Anderson
analysis_notes.quote: He leads the backfield in snaps week two, comes back last week, leads them in snaps again on early downs and third downs.

analysis_notes.summary: Jared Goff excels indoors as a home/divisional favorite, delivering against blitzes and heavy pressure.
analysis_notes.speaker: Brandon Anderson
analysis_notes.quote: Indoors, at home, early window game, division favorite... Goff is going to stand and deliver.

analysis_notes.topic: Ravens fast starts vs Bills second-half comebacks
analysis_notes.summary: Lamar Jackson covers 61% ATS in the first half, while Josh Allen covers 66% ATS in the second half, favoring a Ravens 1H / Bills FT double result.
